max_age_hours.description: Freshness the caller needs, in hours (max 8760). Stored facts younger than this are served; older ones are refreshed live within the time limit. 0 = always refresh live (subject to quotas). -1 = never compute live: batch only, misses come back with coverage: pending. Omitted = serve stored facts, refresh live only for misses and facts past their default max age (§5.4).
max_age_hours.title: Max Age Hours
